from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

from .call_node import CallNodeConfiguration, CallNodeState
from .candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointSkeleton


class PayInformation(BaseModel):
    """Pay information for a job position."""

    range: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)  # min/max
    currency: str = "USD"  # Default currency
    frequency: Literal["hourly", "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "yearly"] | None = None

    @field_validator("range")
    @classmethod
    def validate_pay_range(cls, v: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, float]:
        if v and "min" in v and "max" in v:
            if v["min"] > v["max"]:
                raise ValueError("Minimum pay cannot be greater than maximum pay")
        return v


class JobPositionContext(BaseModel):
    """Context about the job position being discussed."""

    title: str
    description: str
    company: str
    client: str | None = None
    location: str | None = None
    pay: PayInformation = Field(default_factory=PayInformation)
    contract_type: str | None = None  # W2, 1099, etc
    duration: str | None = None
    start_date: str | None = None  # Expected start date
    schedule: str | None = None
    requirements: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)  # Required skills/qualifications
    benefits: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    additional_data: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class CallScriptContext(BaseModel):
    """Context for Call Script"""

    job_position: JobPositionContext = Field(description="the job position being discussed.")
    initial_candidate_context: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate prior to the call"
    )


class CallScript(BaseModel):
    """Script for an AI faciliated call with candidates. This object will be immutable"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for the call script")
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the call script")
    version: str = Field(description="Version of the call script")
    description: str = Field(description="Description of the call script")

    candidate_datapoint_schemas: list[CandidateDatapointSkeleton] = Field(
        default_factory=list, description="List of all candidate datapoint schemas reference in the call script"
    )
    context: CallScriptContext = Field(description="Context for the call script")

    starting_node: str = Field(description="The starting node id of the call script")

    call_nodes: dict[str, CallNodeConfiguration] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Dictionary of call node id to call nodes"
    )


class CallScriptState(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living State of a Call Script"""

    current_node_id: str = Field(description="The current node id of the call script")
    is_completed: bool = Field(default=False, description="Whether the call script is completed")

    candidate_datapoints: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Any datapoint collected for the candidate during the call"
    )
    candidate_signals: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default_factory=dict, description="Any signal collected for the candidate during the call"
    )
    notes: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Any notes collected for the candidate during the call")

    def enrich_from_call_node_state(self, call_node_state: CallNodeState) -> None:
        """Enrich candidate datapoints, signals, and notes from a CallNodeState."""
        # Merge collected datapoints
        self.candidate_datapoints.update(call_node_state.collected_datapoints)
        # Merge collected signals
        self.candidate_signals.update(call_node_state.collected_signals)
        # Extend notes list
        self.notes.extend(call_node_state.notes)

from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .agent import AgentType
from .candidate_datapoint import CandidateDatapointDefinition


class CallNodeAgentFeedbackStatus(StrEnum):
    COMPLETED = "COMPLETED"
    SET_BACK = "SET_BACK"


class CallNodeValidationType(StrEnum):
    # validation using query against data point (leveraging jsonata) - e.g years_experience > 5 && years_experience < 10
    DATAPOINT_QUERY = "DATAPOINT_QUERY"
    # For future reference, natural language validation - e.g "candidates have some experience in management a small to medium team"
    # This will introduce significant latency so skipping for now
    # AI_QUERY = "AI_QUERY"


class CallNodeFailureBehavior(StrEnum):
    # Re-try agent
    RETRY = "RETRY"
    # Move to next node
    SKIP = "SKIP"
    # End the call
    END_CALL = "END_CALL"


class CallNodeSuccessStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling successful completion of a node."""

    next_node_id: str = Field(description="ID of the next node to execute after successful completion")
    description: str = Field(description="Description of what constitutes success for this node")


class CallNodeFailureStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling failed completion of a node."""

    failure_reason: str = Field(description="Reason why this node failed")


class CallNodeFailureRetryStrategy(CallNodeFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling retry of a node."""

    behavior: Literal[CallNodeFailureBehavior.RETRY] = Field(
        default=CallNodeFailureBehavior.RETRY, description="Behavior to retry the agent"
    )
    max_attempts: int = Field(description="Maximum number of retry attempts allowed")


class CallNodeFailureSkipStrategy(CallNodeFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling skipping of a node."""

    behavior: Literal[CallNodeFailureBehavior.SKIP] = Field(
        default=CallNodeFailureBehavior.SKIP, description="Behavior to skip to next node"
    )
    # proceed with next node if none provided
    next_node_id: str | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="ID of the next node to execute after skipping, if none provided proceeds with default next node",
    )


class CallNodeFailureEndCallStrategy(CallNodeFailureStrategy):
    """Configuration for handling skipping of a node."""

    behavior: Literal[CallNodeFailureBehavior.END_CALL] = Field(
        default=CallNodeFailureBehavior.END_CALL, description="Behavior to end the call"
    )


class CallNodeDatapointQueryValidationStrategy(BaseModel):
    """Configuration for handling validation of a node."""

    strategy: Literal[CallNodeValidationType.DATAPOINT_QUERY] = Field(
        default=CallNodeValidationType.DATAPOINT_QUERY, description="Type of validation strategy to use"
    )
    query: str = Field(description="JSONata query string for validating datapoints")


class BaseCallNodeConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """General Node Configuration"""

    id: str = Field(description="Unique identifier for this call node")
    title: str = Field(description="Human-readable title for this node")
    description: str = Field(description="Detailed description of what this node does")
    initial_message: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Optional initial message to send when entering this node"
    )
    node_instructions: str | None = Field(
        default=None, description="Optional specific instructions for the agent processing this node"
    )

    # Configuration for handling successful completion of a node.
    # If none provided, this is a terminal node.
    on_success: CallNodeSuccessStrategy | None = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Configuration for handling successful completion of a node. If none provided, this is a terminal node",
    )

    # Configuration for handling failed completion of a node.
    # If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping
    failure_handling: list[
        CallNodeFailureEndCallStrategy | CallNodeFailureRetryStrategy | CallNodeFailureSkipStrategy
    ] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling failed completion of a node. If no failure_handling is provided, default to skipping",
    )

    # Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a node.
    # All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this node
    # pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile
    pre_requisites: list[CallNodeDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling pre-requisites of a node. All pre-requisites must be satisfied before we can process this node. Pre-requisites are checked against existing candidate profile",
    )


class GreeterNodeConfiguration(BaseCallNodeConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Greeter Node"""

    agent_type: Literal[AgentType.GREETING] = Field(
        default=AgentType.GREETING, description="Type of agent that will handle this greeting node"
    )


class InformationNodeConfiguration(BaseCallNodeConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Information Node"""

    agent_type: Literal[AgentType.INFORMATION] = Field(
        default=AgentType.INFORMATION, description="Type of agent that will handle this information node"
    )


class CloserNodeConfiguration(BaseCallNodeConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Closer Node"""

    agent_type: Literal[AgentType.CLOSER] = Field(
        default=AgentType.CLOSER, description="Type of agent that will handle this closer node"
    )


class QualifierNodeConfiguration(BaseCallNodeConfiguration):
    """Configuration for a Qualifier Node"""

    agent_type: Literal[AgentType.QUALIFIER] = Field(
        default=AgentType.QUALIFIER, description="Type of agent that will handle this qualifier node"
    )

    datapoints_to_collect: list[CandidateDatapointDefinition] = Field(
        description="List of datapoints to collect from the agent",
    )

    # Configuration for handling post-requisites of a node.
    # All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed node
    # post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this node
    post_requisites: list[CallNodeDatapointQueryValidationStrategy] = Field(
        default=[],
        description="Configuration for handling post-requisites of a node. All post-requisites must be satisfied after we have processed node. Post-requisites are checked against ONLY output datapoint from this node",
    )


CallNodeConfiguration = (
    GreeterNodeConfiguration | InformationNodeConfiguration | QualifierNodeConfiguration | CloserNodeConfiguration
)


class CallNodeAgentFeedback(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Feedback from an agent as it is processing a node"""

    status: CallNodeAgentFeedbackStatus = Field(description="Status of the agent feedback")
    feedback: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Optional feedback message from the agent")


class CallNodeState(BaseModel):
    """[INTERNAL] Living State of a call node"""

    call_node_id: str = Field(description="ID of the call node this state represents")
    collected_datapoints: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default={}, description="Dictionary of datapoints collected during node processing"
    )
    collected_signals: dict[str, Any] = Field(
        default={}, description="Dictionary of signals collected during node processing"
    )

from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Self

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class AgentType(StrEnum):
    """Types of driving agents for nodes"""

    GREETING = "greeting"  # Initial contact and introduction
    QUALIFIER = "qualifier"  # Qualification questions
    INFORMATION = "information"  # Information gathering
    CONFIRMATION = "confirmation"  # Confirm details
    CLOSER = "closer"  # Close the call/deal


class BaseAgentConfiguration(BaseModel):
    """Agent responsible for resolving a node"""

    name: str = Field(description="The name of the agent")
    description: str = Field(description="A description of what the agent does")
    agent_instructions: str = Field(description="Instructions for how the agent should behave")

    def merge_config(self, agent_config: Self) -> Self:
        """Merge another agent configuration to this configuration"""
        original_data = self.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        node_data = agent_config.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        merged_data = {**original_data, **node_data}

        return self.__class__(**merged_data)


class GreeterAgentConfiguration(BaseAgentConfiguration):
    """Agent responsible for greeting the user"""

    agent_type: AgentType = Field(default=AgentType.GREETING, description="The type of agent for greeting users")


class QualifierAgentConfiguration(BaseAgentConfiguration):
    """Agent responsible for qualifying the user"""

    agent_type: AgentType = Field(default=AgentType.QUALIFIER, description="The type of agent for qualifying users")


class InformationAgentConfiguration(BaseAgentConfiguration):
    """Agent responsible for gathering information from the user"""

    agent_type: AgentType = Field(
        default=AgentType.INFORMATION, description="The type of agent for gathering information from users"
    )


class ConfirmationAgentConfiguration(BaseAgentConfiguration):
    """Agent responsible for confirming details with the user"""

    agent_type: AgentType = Field(
        default=AgentType.CONFIRMATION, description="The type of agent for confirming details with users"
    )


class CloserAgentConfiguration(BaseAgentConfiguration):
    """Agent responsible for closing the call/deal"""

    agent_type: AgentType = Field(default=AgentType.CLOSER, description="The type of agent for closing calls or deals")


AgentConfiguration = (
    GreeterAgentConfiguration
    | QualifierAgentConfiguration
    | InformationAgentConfiguration
    | ConfirmationAgentConfiguration
    | CloserAgentConfiguration
)
